review: The hymn is the certainty of the promise: 1:1–8 is Num 23:19 (לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב) nearly verbatim with Isa 55:11, the chorus is 1 Thess 1:9–10 with Titus 1:2, and 2:1–8 is Ps 46:3 with Ps 55:23 and Isa 57:15.
1:5–6 quote the Balaam contrast (אֵל … וְלֹא אָדָם) because the Arabic is built on it (رَبّ ومِش إنسان); the Hebrew keeps the verse's own pair rather than a general 'God is not like us'.

2:3–4 keep the psalm's collapse of the mountains as the hypothetical, using בָּלַל/פּוֹרֵר language of Ps 46:3 (בְּהִמּוֹר הָרִים), so the stanza's confidence is set against the psalm's own image of chaos.
